title: Diane Schuur Timeless CD 1986 GRP Records Jazz Vocal Stan Getz Dave Grusin
conditionDescription: Pre-owned. Disc, jewel case and inserts show normal light wear consistent with age and storage. Please review photos for exact condition.
descriptionText:
Diane Schuur - Timeless (GRP Records GRP-D-9540, 1986).
UPC 011105954020. GRP Digital Master, digitally mixed and mastered.
Compact disc manufactured in Japan. Produced by Dave Grusin for
Grusin/Rosen Productions; associate producer Morgan Ames; executive
producers Dave Grusin and Larry Rosen.

Featuring special guest soloist Stan Getz.

1. How Long Has This Been Going On
2. Easy To Love
3. Come Rain Or Come Shine
4. How About Me
5. Do Nothin' Till You Hear From Me
6. A Time For Love
7. I Can't Believe That You're In Love With Me
8. Please Send Me Someone To Love
9. Impossible
10. Travelin' Blues
11. Too Late Now
12. Don't Like Goodbyes

Disc, jewel case and pictured inserts are included. You will receive the exact CD pictured.
